messages.author: Jorge Iulek
messages.body:
Dear all,
I would like to check the "stabilization" of some pmemd runs. Are
there versions of process_minout.perl and process_mdout.perl tailored
for the output of pmemd?
Thank you,
Jorge

messages.author: Rodrigo Galindo-Murillo
messages.body:
You can use CPPTRAJ to read the out files from sander/pmemd. A working
example is available here:
https://amberhub.chpc.utah.edu/reading-the-out-files-and-plotting-different-properties/
Hope that helps!
Rodrigo.

messages.author: Jorge Iulek
messages.body:
Dear Rodrigo,
Yes, fine, it is an alternative and extracted better the variables
to plot. Possibly it is the way to go, yet , at least for pmemd outputs,
it seems to me to be more complete than the perl scripts.
Thank you,
Jorge
